label: Each natural body tends, not by chance, to something that is best for it as…, via acts for an end
meaning: ST I q.2 a.3 co., quinta via, first half: natural bodies act for an end, not by chance but from intention (tending). The Comparator config also verifies necessityModel (the chance-or-intention dichotomy is needed: regular best outcomes, not by chance, with no tending, the formal skeleton of a selection or material-necessity account) and chanceModel (the no-chance premise is needed).
